title: [spec-gap][R-05-130/133/134/135] LOADng 3-way wire/behavior divergence: RREQ signature field, relay rules, retry params, RERR (spec 10)
description: Spec 10.3/10.4: RREQ/RREP wire format includes Signature (48 bytes); flooding rules (destination replies RREP, gradient holder sends intermediate RREP, seen originator+seq drops, else record reverse gradient, decrement hop limit, rebroadcast); RREQ_WAIT_TIME 5s, RREQ_RETRIES 3, INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT 4 expanding ring to MAX_HOP_LIMIT 15; RERR sent toward affected sources and invalidates gradients. Classification: divergent 3-way. Python closest (full flooding rules + optional 48B signature + RouteErrorManager: loadng/discovery.py:147-207, error.py:38-110, tests test_discovery.py/test_error.py) but lacks rate limiting (tracked b7z9.2) and wait/retry loop. C full FSM + rate limits + wait/retry (loadng.c/loadng.h:47-92,374-411) but codecs are fixed 36-byte with NO signature field representation and RERR is codec-only (no manager). Rust: codec + originate only - NO RREQ relay handler, no flooding rules, no rate limit, no RERR manager, no signature field (rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs codecs fixed 36-byte :194-581). Suggested placement: (1) reconcile RREQ/RREP wire format (signature present/absent/optional) across stacks and pin in loadng_messages.json; (2) Rust RREQ relay/flooding handler; (3) wait/retry in Rust+Python; (4) RERR manager for Rust/C. Update b7z9.2 scope: C rate limiting is DONE (loadng.c:41-48,462-490 + tests), so b7z9.2 should read Rust+Python only.
